description: Add support for third-party Mermaid renderer libraries in Slidev presentations. Users should be able to replace the default Mermaid diagram renderer with custom implementations like Beautiful Mermaid by creating a simple setup file in their project.
functional_requirements: Add a new 'mermaid-renderer' module to Slidev's setup system that allows users to override the default Mermaid rendering
Create a user-facing API where users can define custom renderers by creating a setup/mermaid-renderer.ts file that exports a render function
Ensure the custom renderer takes precedence over the default Mermaid renderer when both are present
Update type definitions to include the new mermaid-renderer setup function signature
Add documentation explaining how to install third-party Mermaid libraries and configure custom renderers
Maintain backward compatibility so existing Mermaid diagrams continue to work with the default renderer
